summary: Iteration 8 — Cadabra premium flat redesign + full /app regression. Backend 9/9 pytest pass (brand assets, feed/stats shape, 20-parallel caching with x-bifrost:v1-hit, docs/security/about redirect markers). Frontend: landing '/' loads in 0.40s DCL / 0.41s load; 0 CSS gradients, 0 blurs, 0 horizontal overflow at both 1920 and 390. 'What the chain sees' ledger (data-testid=landing-ledger) renders with Shield/Withdraw/Private trade rows, SOL amounts and ago-timestamps. Launch buttons (landing-launch-nav / -hero / -final) point to /app. Forbidden brand strings absent (Veil, Darkinator, DarkSwap, Houdini, NEAR Intents, 1Click). /app TTI (dk-nav-private visible) = 1.78s. Sidebar renders in exact spec order: Overview, Vanish, Private route, Privacy swap, Swap, Bridge out, Pay, Request, Cash out, Yield, Track order, History, Burner addresses, Referrals, Vault & keys (verified via visual y-sort + style.order 0..14). Mobile 390 bottom tabbar renders in spec order L→R: Overview, Swaps, Vanish, Swap, Pay, More. 'Make a Cadabra wallet' tile icon = /api/bifrost/v1/_brand/mark.png. Onboarding paraphrase present: 'Your wallet, fully out of sight.', 'Restore your Cadabra wallet', 'No extension needed · fund it directly in Cadabra'. Full wallet creation flow passes: Make tile → 2x password inputs filled TestPass!2345 → Create → recovery screen → tick 'My recovery key is saved somewhere safe' → Open → dashboard loaded with 'private balance' content. All 11 sidebar items (Vanish, Swap, Bridge out, Pay, Request, Cash out, Yield, History, Burner addresses, Referrals, Vault & keys) navigate OK — 0 crashes, 0 new console errors during nav. 10-second idle long-task observer = 0 longTasks on Overview; page.evaluate(1+1) returned in 3ms = page remains responsive. Redirects: /app/docs → '/#tech' ✓, /app/security → '/#zk' ✓, /about → '/' ✓. Swap view renders live quote UI for SOL 0.1 (shows quote/receive text). Privacy swap view renders Picked SOL + refund input ('Your Solana refund address') + 'Pick an asset to receive' button; refund address 5tzFkiKscXHK5ZXCGbXZxdw7gTjjD1mBwuoFbhUvuAi9 fills. 80 console 404s observed are benign upstream /_img proxy misses for optional token/chain icons (cdn.jsdelivr.net cryptocurrency-icons + api.houdiniswap assets) that fall back without visual regression.

integration_issues.flow: Private route — Ethereum chain + USDC token picker
integration_issues.issue: In this run, clicking the top-of-'To' 'Select' button on Private route did not surface [data-testid=dk-chain-ethereum]. The asset-picker modal (seen on Swap view) exposes Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum chips so the data exists, but testid-driven selection on the Private route tab was not reached in this iteration. Note: iteration 7 confirmed Private route SOL→ETH USDC → 3 routes + Review swap, so this is likely a selector/timing issue in the current script rather than a product regression. Review swap button + dk-order-id creation was NOT re-verified end-to-end this iteration.

~80 console 'Failed to load resource: 404' errors from /api/bifrost/v1/_img?u=... for cdn.jsdelivr.net/cryptocurrency-icons and api.houdiniswap.com assets when the asset picker opens. Visual fallback works, but the spam clutters console and causes network pressure on first open of the chain/token modal.

action_items: Re-run Private route end-to-end regression (SOL 2 → Ethereum USDC → 0x68b3…41f6 → Review swap → dk-order-id) if end-to-end order creation is a release gate — not verified this iteration.
Consider silently swallowing 404 responses from /_img proxy (serve a 200 transparent 1x1 PNG) so the asset picker doesn't fire ~80 console errors on open; current UX is fine but logs are noisy.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/bifrost.py singleflight + micro-cache correctly surface x-bifrost: v1-hit on repeat fetches (verified under 20× parallel load). Ingress rewrites cache-control to no-store, so clients can't honor the micro-cache — but server-side the cache still protects upstream which was the goal.

LandingPage.jsx — the LiveLedger polls /indexer/v1/feed every 20s with no AbortController; if the tab stays open, requests pile up on slow networks. The micro-cache in bifrost.py absorbs the repetition, but adding AbortController in useEffect cleanup would be cleaner.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all performance / layout / branding / wallet-create / sidebar-order / tabbar-order / redirects / idle-CPU acceptance criteria met; Private route end-to-end to dk-order-id was not reconfirmed in this iteration (passed in iter 7).

seed_data_creation: Created a fresh Cadabra wallet via the UI onboarding flow using TestPass!2345; vault lives only in browser localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter-8 acceptance checks pass except that in this run the Private route 'Select' chain → Ethereum step did not expose [data-testid=dk-chain-ethereum] via the script's path (modal variance between the Private route tab and Swap view asset picker). Iteration 7 already verified Private route end-to-end. The Swap view's asset-picker modal does expose Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum chain chips and USDC rows, so the chain data is intact. Benign 80 upstream _img 404 errors appear on asset-picker open; non-blocking. Backend caching confirmed: x-bifrost: v1-hit appears on repeat requests, latencies drop between first and second 20-parallel batch.
rca of the issue: Not a product RCA — the Private route end-to-end could not be re-driven here because the top 'To' 'Select' button on the Private route tab opens a chain picker whose Ethereum chip either (a) uses a different data-testid in this build or (b) requires selecting the 'To' column (not the 'From' side) first. Script hit the From-side picker. Suggested fix for the next test agent: scope the chain picker open to the 'To' panel container, then query [data-testid=dk-chain-ethereum] within that modal only, then within the resulting token list click the USDC row (there are multiple USDC entries per chain).
